hero.caption: The European windstorm responsible for the 1979 Fastnet Race disaster on August 13, 1979 as it approaches the British Isles. This was taken using the VISSR imaging instrument onboard the SMS-2 geostationary satellite, the original image was taken in grayscale but was superimposed using NASA’s Blue Marble (2002) image through a digital editing software to give a “true-color” effect and make storm structure features easier to see and identify.
